Association PFK Botev (10%) | chairman = Vacant | mgrtitle = Head coach | manager = [[Stanislav Genchev]] | current = 2024–25 Botev Plovdiv season | league = [[First Professional Football League (Bulgaria)|First League]] | season = [[2025–26 First Professional Football League (Bulgaria)|2025–26]] | position = First League, 8th of 16 | website = {{URL|http://botevplovdiv.bg/}} | kit_alt1 = Yellow jersey, black shorts and yellow socks | pattern_la1 = _macronlegion26by | pattern_b1 = _macronlegion26by | pattern_ra1 = _macronlegion26by | pattern_sh1 = _macronshedeco2425by | pattern_so1 = _botevplovdiv2627hl | leftarm1 = 000000 | body1 = 000000 | rightarm1 = 000000 | shorts1 = 000000 | socks1 = 000000 | pattern_la2 = _macronwyverneco24cw | pattern_b2 = _macronwyverneco24cw | pattern_ra2 = _macronwyverneco24cw | pattern_sh2 = | pattern_so2 = _macronhoops18cw | leftarm2 = 87CEFA | body2 = 87CEFA | rightarm2 = 87CEFA | shorts2 = 87CEFA | socks2 = 87CEFA | pattern_la3 = _macronwyverneco24yb | pattern_b3 = _macronwyverneco24yb | pattern_ra3 = _macronwyverneco24yb | pattern_sh3 = | pattern_so3 = _macronhoops1byL | leftarm3 = FFFF00 | body3 = FFFF00 | rightarm3 = FFFF00 | shorts3 = FFFF00 | socks3 = 000000 }} '''Botev Plovdiv''' ({{langx|bg|Ботев Пловдив}}, {{IPA|bg|ˈbɔtɛf ˈpɫɔvdif|pron}}) is a Bulgarian professional [[Association football|football]] club based in [[Plovdiv]], which competes in the [[First Professional Football League (Bulgaria)|Parva Liga]], the top tier of Bulgarian football. Founded on 11 March 1912,{{cite web |url=https://botevplovdiv.bg/article/nasheto-nachalo |title=Нашето начало |trans-title=Our beginning |date=11 March 2019 |website=www.botevplovdiv.bg |access-date=11 March 2019 |language=bg}} it is the oldest active football club in Bulgaria{{cite web |url=https://sheffieldfc.com/the-worlds-first/pioneers |title=The Club of Pioneers |website=www.sheffieldfc.com |publisher=Sheffield Football Club |access-date=23 May 2026 }} and is widely regarded as one of the country’s historically significant clubs. Named after Bulgarian poet and revolutionary [[Hristo Botev]],{{cite web |url=https://botevplovdiv.bg/patron |title=Клубът – Патрон |trans-title=Club – Patron |website=www.botevplovdiv.bg |access-date=23 November 2019 |language=bg}} the club plays its home matches at [[Stadion Hristo Botev (Plovdiv)|Hristo Botev Stadium]] in Plovdiv. Botev has won two [[List of Bulgarian football champions|Bulgarian league titles]], four [[Bulgarian Cup]]s, one [[Bulgarian Supercup]] and one [[Balkans Cup]]. The club’s best performance in European competition came when it reached the quarter-finals of the [[UEFA Cup Winners’ Cup|Cup Winners’ Cup]]. Throughout its history, Botev has remained an important presence in Bulgarian football and one of the country’s traditionally best-supported clubs."}}
